pages.title: Insulation and Heaters
pages.text:
[#](FFFFFF)[#]() **Key points**

- [#](FFFFFF)[#]() Sew insulation onto any armor at a **Sewing Table**
- Ready-made sets: Goat Fur, Hoglin and Chameleon Scale
- [#](FFFFFF)[#]() A fuelled **Hearth** keeps an area comfortable

pages.title: Armor
pages.text: Armor is the main defence. Take any armor to a **Sewing Table** and sew insulation onto it. Insulators such as Goat Fur and Hoglin Hide have their own item tab. [#](2E5AAC)[JEI](entry://start_here/tools)[#]() has a Sewing Recipes category.

pages.title: Sewing Table
pages.text: Crafted from wool and planks. Adds insulation from items like Goat Fur to armor, held as cold or heat resistance.

pages.title: Fur and hide
pages.text: Goat Fur and Hoglin Hide come from goats and hoglins. Rabbit Hide and Leather sew on too: Rabbit Hide is the best heat insulator outside the Nether, tied with Chameleon Molt once it has turned toward heat. Finished sets exist: Goat Fur, Hoglin and Chameleon Scale armor. Hover any piece to read its insulation.

pages.title: Goat Fur Parka
pages.text: One of the ready-made sets. Its insulation is shown in the tooltip. Cold Sweat's Chameleon, a tameable lizard, sheds scales for another set.

pages.title: Blocks
pages.text:
A **Hearth** keeps the area around it comfortable. It takes fuel (see the Hearth Fuel category in JEI).\
\
A **Boiler** warms and an **Icebox** cools. Put a Smokestack on top to make an area livable.

pages.title: Hearth
pages.text: Fuel it and put it in an enclosed room. It switches on by itself when someone inside is too cold (or too hot, with cold fuel) and only burns fuel then; no redstone needed. Boiler and Icebox work the same way. Fuels and range are in JEI.

pages.title: Waterskin
pages.text: Cold Sweat's own drink container. Its tooltip shows the keys to drink and pour. A Create Spout can fill it. It carries [#](2E5AAC)[Thirst](entry://survival/thirst)[#]() purity: purify it in a furnace or campfire.

[#](FFFFFF)[#]() **In depth.** A full Create netherite [#](2E5AAC)[diving set](entry://ocean/diving)[#]() (netherite backtank, diving helmet, netherite leggings, diving boots) adds heat dampening and shrugs off the wet effect. The backtank tooltip shows the hint.
